title: fix(app-shell): Studio's flow text slots insert and prescribe {{ }}, and notify recipients write CEL value envelopes (objectui#11824)
body:
Fixes #11824
Clause-②: no

Studio's flow text slots now insert and prescribe `{{ }}` (ADR-0032 Decision 3: "One delimiter, `{{ }}`; single `{ }` deleted."), and the notify recipient picker writes the spellings `@objectstack/spec` 18 accepts. This is the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110, on the `18.0.0-next.0` line objectui moved to in objectui#12030.

## Measured first (installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0)

- **A1 holds.** `NotifyConfigSchema`, `ScreenConfigSchema` and `EndConfigSchema` refuse `Hi {name}` and accept `Hi {{ name }}` in each of the five slots: notify `title` / `message`, screen `title` / `description`, end `message` (refused outcome). The refusal is the spec's `TEXT_SLOT_TEMPLATE_REFUSAL`. The new test file pins all five against the installed spec.
- **A3 is disproved for the recipients.** `recipients` is a value slot in spec 18, not a text slot. The spec refuses `{record.owner}` and also `{{ record.owner }}` there, and prescribes a CEL value envelope: "Write `{record.owner}` as { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.owner' }". So the picker's cutover is to the envelope, not to `{{ }}`. That follows the ruling's intent (the Studio flow-dialect cutover, ADR-0032) in the spelling the contract asks for.
- **A2 was not the whole set.** The descriptor publishes the screen `title` / `description` as plain strings with no dialect marker, so online the served fields would still default to single-brace mode. The screen preview also rendered single-brace tokens only, so a `{{ }}` title showed as `{Acme}`. Both are fixed here (below).

## What changed

- **Five text slots, hole mode.** `FlowConfigField.refMode` gains `'hole'`, set on exactly the five slots. In a hole field:
  - the picker inserts `{{ x }}` (`VariableTextInput` mode `hole`);
  - a single-brace token is flagged inline, with the double-brace spelling as the fix (the existing `engine.flowExpr.singleBraceTemplate` check, now wired in);
  - the unknown-reference note reads only each hole's variable path, so a `| currency` formatter is not taken for a reference.
  Placeholders and help (en, plus the zh designer overlay) show `{{ }}`. `mergeServerFlowFields` keeps `refMode: 'hole'` on a served field of the same config key; label, help and kind stay the server's.
- **Screen preview.** The title and description are rendered by `interpolateHoles`. A known hole is substituted (dotted paths walk nested values; a formatter is not modelled), an unknown hole stays as written, and a single brace is left as written. The single-brace `interpolate` had no other caller and is removed. `defaultValueTemplates` still detects `{…}` in field defaults, which are a value slot and outside this card.
- **Recipients.** A Record field row writes `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.FIELD' }`. A new Expression row writes any other CEL value envelope (for example a flow variable, `ownerId`), using the bare-reference picker and the CEL brace check. Other rows are now literal text with no picker, because the `{var}` picker could only produce a refused value. An unedited envelope is written back as it was read, including `ast` / `meta`. A stored `{record.owner}` string is shown under Other and kept as typed. The spec refuses it and ships no conversion for it: under the template an absent key wrote nothing, under CEL it fails. So whether to rewrite it is the author's call.
- **Unchanged:** CEL roles keep their brace check, and every other text field keeps its single-brace mode. The pin uses the http `body`.
- **Changesets:** new `.changeset/11824-flow-text-slots-double-brace.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, minor). `.changeset/11788-notify-recipients-picker.md` gets a one-clause correction, frontmatter unchanged. The Record field row is now described as the CEL value envelope it writes.

## Pins

`flowTextSlots.doubleBrace-11824.test.tsx` covers:
- the spec refuses `{x}` and accepts `{{ x }}` in each slot;
- the hole-mode set is exactly the five, and each is a slot the spec's `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` names;
- each slot's picker inserts `{{ customer }}`;
- the served screen title / description keep hole mode;
- a single brace is flagged with the `{{ }}` fix, and a formatter hole is clean;
- an out-of-scope hole is the note;
- the CEL alert equals `validateExpressionClient('predicate', …)`;
- the http body still inserts `{x}` and is not flagged;
- `interpolateHoles` works as described above.

The PENDING pins from objectui#12030 in `FlowRecipientsField.test.tsx` are now load-bearing:
- every value the picker writes passes `NotifyConfigSchema`;
- a Record field commit is the envelope and is accepted;
- the stored single-brace spellings read as Other, round-trip byte for byte, and are refused.

## Verification (head `a847d3a`)

- Targeted vitest, from the repo root:
  - the four touched test files: 73 passed;
  - every app-shell test importing a touched module (36 files): 555 passed, 1 skipped;
  - `FlowNodeInspector*` + `FlowRunner*` (32 files): 352 passed.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `new-line-citations`, `control-bytes`, `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `test-path-roots`, `vi-mock-specifiers`, `vi-mock-inherit`, `vi-mock-override-shape`, `installed-pin-claims`, plus `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec …"). It is not from this diff: the diff touches no `package.json` or changeset config, which is what that scan reads.
- eslint, narrowed to the 12 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 12 files, 0 errors, 10 warnings, all `react-refresh/only-export-components` on files that already exported helpers. The root `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions` project, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- **NOT MEASURED: full `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`.** Reason: two 9-minute waits on the shared verify lock ended in a queue timeout, behind a sibling run that held the lock for over 30 minutes. In its place, a narrowed `tsc` (the package's `tsconfig.test.json` settings, `files` = the 12 changed files) ran with exit 0 and 0 errors, over 57 app-shell sources reached through imports. The full type-check is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope by ruling ("only those" five).** Spec 18 also treats the notify `actionUrl`, the http `url` and each http `headers` value as text slots (`FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS`, migration entry `flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused`). It refuses single-brace value slots too: script `inputs`, screen `defaults`, the record `fields` maps. Studio still defaults those fields and key/value cells to the single-brace picker, and the script `inputs` and screen `defaults` help still show `{var}`. Measured: `NotifyConfigSchema` refuses `actionUrl: '/x/{record.id}'`, `HttpConfigSchema` refuses `url` and `headers` with `{x}`, and `ScriptConfigSchema` / `ScreenConfigSchema` refuse `{x}` in `inputs` / `defaults`. This is reported for a closure card. It is not changed here.
- The blank Notify title hold is objectui#12343, which remains open. Its pin is untouched.
- "Offers the `{{ }}` fix" is the inline message naming the double-brace spelling. There is no one-click rewrite button, because a single-brace token such as `{a + b}` has no hole spelling and the spec prescribes an `assignment` for it.
